launches.name: IrisGo for Solopreneurs
launches.tagline: AI workflow automation: show it once, let it run
launches.description: IrisGo helps solopreneurs automate recurring work. Get daily briefs, triage email, track to-dos, and turn demonstrated tasks into reusable workflows with Watch & Learn. Spend less time on admin and more time building your business. Free during beta.

launches.name: OpenSwarm
launches.tagline: A swarm of agents, in the same place you work
launches.description: Stop bolting AI onto your computer. OpenSwarm is an AI-first operating system where agents run the whole machine: apps create themselves, browsers control themselves, and swarms of agents work together. Your OS just became an infinite canvas, and your work just transformed from you doing one task at a time, to orchestrating dozens in parallel. Tell it what you want and a swarm of agents does the work with you at the helm.

launches.name: Wabi
launches.tagline: A new kind of messenger that gets things done
launches.description: a new kind of messenger that makes apps and gets things done for you and your friends. We’re building the OS for the agentic era - software that adapts to your life, gets things done, and makes more room for the people and things that matter.

launches.name: GeckIt
launches.tagline: Kanban board for your Claude Code chats
launches.description: Working with several Claude Code chats at once? GeckIt puts them on a Kanban board, so you see which one is working, which one waits for you and which one is done. It runs your own Claude Code on your Claude subscription, no API key. Free and open source, Mac, Windows, Linux.

launches.name: Ambiguous Workspace
launches.tagline: 18 productivity apps built for AI agents and humans
launches.description: Ever ask your AI agent to do something and it says “I don’t have access”? 🙃 Most of the apps where work happens weren’t built for agents, so they either get stuck or end up borrowing your login. That's why we're excited to launch Ambiguous Workspace: 18 productivity apps reimagined so work flows between your team and agents. They include Docs, Mail, Chat, Sheets, CRM, and more. Each agent has its own identity. You can send it an email, message it, assign it a task, or mention it in a comment.

launches.name: Flowo
launches.tagline: ADHD day planner that re-plans when your day slips
launches.description: Most planners help you make a plan. Flowo helps when the plan stops matching the day. It builds your day from tasks, fixed events and limits like sleep and meals, then rebuilds what is left when something runs long, and shows what moved and why. Brain dump by typing or voice, habits that scale down in hard weeks, and a Pomodoro timer that starts from the plan. No account; planning data stays encrypted on your phone. Free on iPhone and Android, with an optional Pro plan.

launches.name: DailyHub
launches.tagline: A personal command center for projects, tasks, and habits.
launches.description: A personal command center for people who juggle more than one project at a time — founders, consultants, indie builders, anyone with client work, side projects, and a few non-negotiable daily habits. DailyHub is not a replacement for Linear, Jira, or Notion. It is the morning surface: what is open, what belongs where, what must happen today, and what you already finished.

launches.name: Leanback
launches.tagline: Personal AI assistant for managing engineering teams
launches.description: Leanback is your personal AI assistant for managing engineering teams. It checks in with your team, reads every ticket and calendar, and delivers a clear action plan inside Slack, before your first coffee.

launches.name: pmtui
launches.tagline: Autopilot for long-running AI sessions in terminal
launches.description: pmtui focuses on managing multiple agents and solving long-horizon tasks. Autopilot does what an agent loop does, except loops drift once the work runs long. So pmtui keeps the loop outside the agent and rebuilds the prompt each time from your goal and the agent's own last status. You choose how often to check back, and it only surfaces what really needs your attention

launches.name: Cinch – Reminders & Tasks
launches.tagline: Clean, privacy-first task manager for Apple Reminders
launches.description: Cinch is a fast, lightweight native client for Apple Reminders across iOS, macOS, watchOS, and visionOS. Built for the future: CLI for Agents – Give LLMs access to your Reminders while keeping all data local and private. Zero telemetry, zero tracking, and no custom databases. Your data stays strictly in your personal iCloud. Clean layout with generous spacing, visual daily timelines, calendar integration, natural language input, and interactive widgets.

launches.name: Kempt: Home Maintenance
launches.tagline: Home maintenance, on autopilot
launches.description: Kempt is the app I wish I had when I bought my first house. Kempt knows your appliances by model number, tracks what's due, and sends a Sunday Brief of what needs doing next: filters, gutters, freeze prep, and the small things nobody remembers until they're expensive. Live on the App Store now. $39.99 a year, 30 days free for Product Hunt users, link in the first comment.

launches.name: Everframe
launches.tagline: In-app bug reports with the context developers actually need
launches.description: Everframe replaces the patchwork of bug form, crash reporter, chat thread and task board with a single product. - Capture bugs and crashes from iOS, Android, React Native, web, smart TV and Roku apps. - Let AI triage them and a coding agent propose the fix. - Talk to reporters from the ticket. - Track everything on built-in boards. Fewer tools, fewer handoffs, and a clear path from the moment something breaks to the moment it is fixed.

launches.name: Quiet Pomodoro
launches.tagline: A focus app for people who hate focus apps
launches.description: Most focus apps are cluttered enough to be a distraction themselves. Quiet Pomodoro is a clean, minimal timer for iPhone: pick a task, start a session, and it blocks your distracting apps until the break. Daily streaks show your progress. That's all.

launches.name: Kanbanto
launches.tagline: One task board for your team and their AI agents
launches.description: A Trello-style kanban board where your team and their AI agents work from the same plan. Connect Claude, ChatGPT or your own agent: it turns emails and notes into tasks, picks up the next one, does the work and reports on the card, not in a chat you'll lose. You see where everything stands and decide what's done. Run projects, sales, support or store orders on it, with timelines, time logging and custom fields. Free with the AI you already have: no per-seat price, no AI credits. Self-hostable.

launches.name: Client Delivery Systems That Scale
launches.tagline: Build repeatable client delivery workflows that scale
launches.description: Building Client Delivery Systems That Scale is a practical guide for freelancers and small service teams that want more consistent project delivery without unnecessary complexity. It covers client onboarding, scope and capacity planning, workflow stages, communication, quality checks, approvals, documentation, and continuous improvement. The focus is on creating a repeatable delivery process that remains flexible enough for real client work.

launches.name: Dawnlet
launches.tagline: Your day, gently organized.
launches.description: A day is one thing; most apps make it five. Dawnlet shows events, todos, habits, money, time and the small things you want to remember as a single day — eleven modules sharing one set of categories. Reminders are computed on your device. No analytics, ever. No ads, no tracking. Free to use, with Dawnlet Plus from $2.92 a month.

launches.name: marble work
launches.tagline: From tool chaos to marketing symphony
launches.description: AI agents. Real projects. One tool. Most teams run their AI in one app and their projects, clients and hours in another. marble work does both. Describe AI teammates in plain words, connect your tools and chain their steps with human ones: the agent researches, you review, the agent delivers. Plus projects, clients, budgets, time tracking and attendance. Bring your own AI key, no credits, no markup.

launches.name: Trackboard
launches.tagline: Take every track from first idea to release
launches.description: Trackboard is a kanban board for music projects. Each song is a card moving through seven stages, from brainstorming to promotion. Listen to demos and mixes on a waveform and comment on the exact second. Every stage has its own checklist. Invite collaborators, and import all your DAW projects in one go. Free for 30 tracks, Pro €6/month.

launches.name: Automations in Perplexity Computer
launches.tagline: Automations that remember, act, and keep work moving
launches.description: Computer Automations turns recurring work into reliable, ongoing workflows. Define a task once... such as monitoring sources, compiling reports, updating trackers, or drafting follow-ups... and an agent executes it on a schedule or in response to triggers. Built for professionals, teams, and operations leaders who need continuity without constant supervision, it remembers prior runs, builds on accumulated context, and acts proactively rather than waiting for a prompt.

launches.name: Foley
launches.tagline: A voice to-do list that files, plans and asks first
launches.description: Say what needs doing. Foley turns it into a task with the project, date and reminder already set, and asks when it isn't sure instead of guessing. When plans change, say so and it moves the task. Ask it to plan your day, or what to work on first, and it answers from your list. Capture from your Apple Watch. The desktop app is free with no account, using your own OpenRouter key. Foley Pro runs the AI for you and syncs every device. On iPhone, Android, Mac, Windows and the web.

launches.name: ParakeetAI 2.0
launches.tagline: The ultimate way to prepare for your job interview
launches.description: ParakeetAI takes you from "what will they ask?" to "I nailed it." Start with the Question Bank: real interview questions grouped by company and ranked by how often they come up. Rehearse them out loud with an AI interviewer that asks, listens and follows up on your answers, then read the transcript back. On the day, ParakeetAI listens to the real interview and drafts your answers live. Your first mock interview is free.

launches.name: HuntYourTribe
launches.tagline: Startup jobs in India, straight from career pages
launches.description: HuntYourTribe indexes jobs straight from the career pages of startups and SMBs hiring in India, so you find real openings that never make it to LinkedIn or Indeed. No duplicates, no ghost listings. • Fresh jobs every 4 hours • All the filters you'd expect • Email alerts + company watchlist • Search & save jobs from Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and other AI apps via MCP • Free portfolio page to show your work

launches.name: Sage from Saywise
launches.tagline: Your 24/7 AI recruiter
launches.description: Sage is your 24/7 AI recruiter. Sage works like a human recruiter and does everything for you even while you're sleeping. Sage hand-picks the best opportunities for you the moment they come out, prepares your resume and creates a free portfolio site, auto-applies for you (if you want), and runs mock interviews and gives you feedback. The best part: you just text her anytime. No app required, no complicated sign-up process.

launches.name: It's a Numbers Game
launches.tagline: Job hunting shouldn't be this difficult!
launches.description: If you're out of work and applying to dozens of roles, you know the drill. retype your name, address, phone and work history on every single form. It's a numbers game (itsanumbersgame.xyz) fills those twenty fields from your saved profile, logs each job on a tracking board, and warns you when you've already applied somewhere. Import your resume, add the Chrome extension, and spend your energy on the applications instead of the paperwork. Free forever.

launches.name: Pavago
launches.tagline: A Frictionless Hiring Platform
launches.description: Scout OS is a frictionless talent marketplace. Search vetted remote candidates by skill, watch their intro videos, then shortlist, interview, and send the contract from one app. Free to browse. $99/mo to interview. Pay only when you hire, with a 60-day replacement guarantee.

launches.name: Shortlist
launches.tagline: Tailor your resume to every job, using only your real facts
launches.description: Shortlist tailors your resume to each job. Paste a job post and AI suggests edits drawn only from your own profile; you approve every change. Real LaTeX PDFs, 14 templates by field, a free ATS checker, and links that show when a recruiter opens it.

launches.name: Cairo AI
launches.tagline: AI for human performance at work
launches.description: Cairo AI connects workforce analytics, skills intelligence, AI training, and simulations to help organizations develop their people. Each teammate takes a quick psychometric assessment and a weekly check-in, then gets their own trait cards, skill metrics, and AI-built development plans and practice scenarios. Spot friction, predict turnover, and test decisions like new hires before making them. Powered by Rosetta, our behavior model. Available on web, iOS, Android and Slack.

launches.name: Cofounder Pages
launches.tagline: Free co-founder job board for startups with a live product
launches.description: Find a co-founder role at a startup that already has a live product, or post yours for free. CTO, CEO, COO and growth roles, every listing checked by hand. Candidates apply with a CV, a short note on their track record and their LinkedIn, and it lands straight in the founder's inbox. No accounts, no recruiters. Product Hunt special: use code PH45LAUNCH and your post stays up 45 days instead of 25.

launches.name: WinJob
launches.tagline: Career OS for the AI & Gamification Era
launches.description: Meet WinJob: The all-in-one AI Career OS built by engineers, for everyone. Stop juggling tools and start landing offers. Tailor resumes, discover likely interview questions, practice with AI mock interviews, get system design and architecture feedback, and follow an interview-date sprint plan. WinJob turns scattered prep into one guided path from application to offer to promotion. From prep to your next promotion, WinJob is your unfair advantage to win the tech career you deserve.

launches.name: in-meet
launches.tagline: Find jobs in India from checked company career pages
launches.description: Find role matches in India from checked official job postings. Set your role, city and experience, then visit the employer's page to confirm details and apply. No signup needed. Coverage is limited.

launches.name: Lumil
launches.tagline: Find who is hiring, straight from company career pages
launches.description: Lumil reads job postings directly from company career pages and maps who is hiring as an interactive universe. Explore companies, see how well each role fits you and why, and apply in minutes with a cover letter and answers tailored to the role !

launches.name: HireNXT
launches.tagline: Scale fast with AI-vetted Tech talents & Agents on Demand
launches.description: HireNXT connects companies with vetted tech talent through an AI-powered staff augmentation platform — smarter matching, faster engagements, verified quality along with Enterprise Agents and automation

launches.name: Hirevire
launches.tagline: Watch every applicant answer your questions
launches.description: Hirevire replaces first-round phone screens with async video, audio and text answers. Candidates need no login. New since our 2023 launch: 1. AI writes screening questions from your job title, or turns a pasted list into set-up questions. 2. AI drafts a scorecard from the job, then scores videos, answers and resumes. 3. Rerun a score with a note. General rules go to the job's scoring memory. 4. MCP server: create jobs, read scores and move candidates from Claude, ChatGPT or any MCP client.

launches.name: RiseRole
launches.tagline: Walk into every interview ready.
launches.description: For one job: a resume tailored without inventing anything, likely interview questions with answers from your own experience, and a practice interview. From $1 per job, no subscription. RiseRole helps you prepare. It does not guarantee a job or an interview.

launches.name: Kaam Ki Khoj
launches.tagline: Writing  Discover Jobs. Connect with Opportunities.
launches.description: 🔎 Looking for your next career opportunity? Meet Kaam Ki Khoj — a platform designed to help job seekers explore employment opportunities and help employers connect with potential candidates. 💼 Explore job opportunities 🏢 Discover companies 📄 Build your CV 🚀 Visit Kaam Ki Khoj, explore the platform, and share your feedback to help us improve the job search experience!

launches.name: AutoReached AI
launches.tagline: Get interviews while you sip coffee ☕
launches.description: AutoReached helps job seekers go beyond the traditional “Apply and wait” approach. It scans major job boards to find roles that match your profile, identifies the people worth reaching out to at those companies, and creates a personalized outreach plan. From LinkedIn connection requests and personalized follow-ups to email fallback — AutoReached handles the outreach while you focus on preparing for the interview. **Find the right jobs. Reach the right people. Get closer to the interview.**

launches.name: First Jobby
launches.tagline: The best job finder platform to start your career
launches.description: First Jobby helps you land your first job. It's completely focused on entry-level roles and jobs for candidates with less than 3 years of experience. No senior listings, just real opportunities for grads and early-career professionals.

launches.name: worth.
launches.tagline: Know what the job is worth. Ad checking for jobseekers.
launches.description: worth. let's job seekers know what the job is really **worth**. Look up on the site or install the Chrome extension, worth compares the salary to a big database and gives you the best guess if the salary is missing. If the salary is there worth still checks if the job ad is asking too much or too little or is just about right.

launches.name: Interfell Talent Scout
launches.tagline: Describe the hire, see vetted LatAm candidates on video
launches.description: Describe who you need in plain words (or upload the job post) and get ranked, ready-to-work candidates from 18 Latin American countries. Every profile includes a video intro, assessment results and verified availability. Personal data stays hidden until you request an interview. Free with a work email: sign in with a 6-digit code, no password. Found your hire? Bring them on directly, through remote staffing, or via payroll.

launches.name: LandInterview
launches.tagline: Free ATS resume checker built for Indian freshers
launches.description: LandInterview scores your resume against a specific target role, shows the keyword gaps and formatting issues that cause ATS rejections, and gives rewrites you can paste straight back in. Unlike generic checkers, it's role-specific (frontend, backend, full stack, data) and built for Indian freshers. Free ATS score with rechecks; Pro is a one-time ₹99.

launches.name: Rill Browser
launches.tagline: The browser where Claude Code and Codex work beside you
launches.description: Rill is an AI-native browser built around the Claude Code and Codex you already use. Browse normally, then press ⌘E on any page to turn what you're looking at into a task for your agent. Rill finds the right project, passes along the context, and the agent works while you keep browsing. It also sorts your tabs into themes, turns your history into days you can search, and brings every project your agents are working on into one place. Free, on the plan you already have.

launches.name: Velozity
launches.tagline: The Multiplayer AI Office where your team and agents work
launches.description: Your team chats in one app, meets in another, and every AI works alone. Velozity brings it all into one place. Chat, audio and video calls with transcripts, tasks, calendar and files, plus AI agents (Claude, Codex, etc.) on the subscriptions you already pay for. Every agent shares the same context, so work moves between people and agents without having to re-explain. For startups, teams in dev, product, sales, and ops, or solo users juggling several AIs. No second AI bill. Free to start.

launches.name: Onepin
launches.tagline: AI voiceover with every name, price and date said right
launches.description: AI voices sound human now. But they still guess names from the spelling, and nobody has time to listen to every line. Onepin runs on the voices you already use (ElevenLabs, OpenAI, Google, 30+ more), spells out prices and dates, checks names against a 4M-word pronunciation dictionary, scores every line, and fixes the wrong word without re-rendering the take. Built for teams shipping AI voiceover in several languages: product videos, dubbing, courses. Free to start, no credit card required.

launches.name: OpenBot
launches.tagline: Grok Bot alternative: free, local, open-source, multiplayer
launches.description: OpenBot is an open-source workspace for AI teammates. Connect Claude, ChatGPT, Grok, OpenCode, or custom agents on Mac, Windows, and iOS. Give agents clear roles, let them delegate work, and invite your team to collaborate live with the same agents.

launches.name: FastRouter.ai
launches.tagline: Route requests to the right LLM for cost, latency & quality
launches.description: FastRouter is a unified AI gateway and control plane for developers and enterprise teams building with LLMs. It routes every request to the right model across 200+ LLMs through one OpenAI-compatible API, optimizing for cost, latency, quality, and reliability. With intelligent routing, failover, observability, and governance, teams can scale AI apps without vendor lock-in or code changes.

launches.name: Busabase
launches.tagline: The general system of record for AI agents
launches.description: Different agents. One shared base. Busabase is a general-purpose database and workspace for people and AI agents. Keep business records, docs, skills, and apps in one place so the next task can build on them. Connect Claude Code, Codex, and more. Set access, review changes when needed, and see what changed. Busabase is open source, with Cloud, Personal Desktop, and self-hosting options.

launches.name: Claude Haiku 5.5
launches.tagline: Anthropic's fastest and most capable Haiku yet
launches.description: Claude Haiku 5.5 is Anthropic's fastest and most capable small model, built for high-volume, cost-sensitive tasks like summarization, classification, coding subagents, customer support, and browser use.

launches.name: Opengeni
launches.tagline: Ship AI agents within minutes. Infrastructure for Agents
launches.description: Ship AI agents to production in hours. Opengeni gives you sessions that recover from failures, isolated sandboxes, 100+ integrations, human approvals, and visibility into every step and dollar spent. Focus on your agents. We handle the infrastructure. Self-host for free, or get started on our cloud. For this launch, the first 100 users get $100 in cloud credit. Promo-code: PRODUCTHUNT100

launches.name: Zernio
launches.tagline: Marketing infrastructure for products and agents
launches.description: Zernio is the marketing infrastructure 200,000 developers build products on. We absorb the integrations, platform approvals and maintenance behind every channel, all on official APIs, so you can start building today. One API covers 16 social platforms, ads on 7 networks, WhatsApp, iMessage, and phone numbers with calls and SMS that you buy inside Zernio. Use the REST API in your code, or let your coding agent do the same through our MCP server and CLI.

launches.name: AUDR by Chargebee
launches.tagline: Open standard for tracking agent run costs
launches.description: AUDR (Agent Usage Detail Record) is an open standard, for capturing who initiated an agent run and what it cost across every system that run touches. Inspired by the telecom industry's Call Detail Record, AUDR defines a common JSON schema that any harness, router, or billing system can emit and ingest. Three core rules make it work: a shared run ID minted by the harness, clear field ownership, and strict merge rules where conflicts are rejected and corrections are new records.

launches.name: Invofox Self Serve
launches.tagline: 99% accurate document extraction, SLA guaranteed
launches.description: Invofox turns any document into clean, structured JSON through one API. Get 99%+ accuracy backed by SLAs. If we make a mistake, you don’t pay for that document. Invofox handles parsing, extraction, validation, edge cases, and monitoring behind one endpoint, then automatically learns from your feedback to keep improving on the documents your business actually processes.

launches.name: Incredible
launches.tagline: Vibe computing. Control your computer with your voice.
launches.description: Incredible is your personal AI assistant that gets work done on your computer. It learns how you work by watching you do it. Show it a task on your computer, talk through the steps, and let it handle the routine from there, from processing invoices and updating your CRM to editing spreadsheets.

launches.name: Mistral Large 4
launches.tagline: Mistral's 1T parameter open weight frontier model
launches.description: Mistral Large 4 (aka Le Chonk) is Mistral's largest model yet: a natively multimodal mixture of experts model with 1T total and 49B active parameters and a 1M token context window. Mistral says it is the strongest open weight model from the US or Europe, and it ranks top 5 on the Artificial Analysis Cyber Index. It was trained in Mistral's own European datacenters. The preview API is live today on Mistral Studio, with open weights due by the end of October.

launches.name: Together Link
launches.tagline: Use open models in your harness
launches.description: Together Link connects coding agents to open models on Together AI, letting developers keep their existing tools and workflows while reducing model costs.

launches.name: Web Search API
launches.tagline: Give AI Agents Access to Live Internet Data
launches.description: Web Search API lets your AI agents and applications search the Internet and ground their responses in live information, instead of guessing URLs or relying on a model's training cutoff.

launches.name: Cekura Bench
launches.tagline: Speech-to-speech model benchmarks on live phone calls
launches.description: Cekura Bench publishes voice AI benchmarks you can verify. Our new speech-to-speech benchmark tests 9 realtime voice models, including GPT Realtime 2.1, Gemini Live, Grok and Phonic, as complete phone agents on live calls: 82 scenarios, three runs each. Models are ranked on reliability, data accuracy, stalled calls, response time and cost, and every call transcript is public. Cekura Bench also covers voice agent benchmarks and STT benchmarks, with TTS benchmarks coming soon.

launches.name: Rool
launches.tagline: Your private AI machine. Files, ideas, AI in one workspace.
launches.description: Rool is your private AI workspace. Bring your files, ideas and AI together in one place, on your own machine in the cloud. Unlike mainstream AI, Rool never sells your data, shows no ads and never uses your content to train AI. Your data is stored in Finland, under EU law. It's AI that runs on your terms, with full control and privacy. Built for privacy-conscious individuals, teams and creators. Try Rool free and own your AI.

launches.name: Cue
launches.tagline: Put your AirPods in, your Mac starts focusing
launches.description: Your headphones become a focus switch. Put your AirPods in and your Mac turns on your Focus mode, blocks distracting sites and starts a timer in the notch. Take them out: break time, sites come back. Also in the notch: now playing, volume and brightness, your own colors, session history and two tiny buddies that react to everything. Free, private, macOS 14+ on Apple Silicon. Vibe-coded by one person and Claude.

launches.name: Gemini Agent for Google Cloud
launches.tagline: The work agent that runs on both Gemini and Claude
launches.description: Gemini agent is Google Cloud's single, universal agent for work. Give it an objective, not instructions: it plans, uses your company's skills and tools, connects to Workspace, Microsoft 365, Slack, Salesforce, Jira or any MCP server, and hands back finished docs, decks or code. Unlike chat assistants that stop at an answer, it keeps running in the cloud for hours or days, spins up coworker agents with their own email and calendar, and routes each job to the right model under hard spend caps.

launches.name: Off the Record
launches.tagline: Block AI from transcribing your meetings.
launches.description: Off the Record reshapes your voice in real time so people can understand you while AI notetakers and hidden interview copilots struggle to transcribe it.

launches.name: HeyPi
launches.tagline: Build and ship anything live, in-meetings
launches.description: Most AI meeting tools capture what happened and send you notes. HeyPi follows the conversation in real time, remembers what was said across current and past meetings, privately surfaces key information when useful, and starts handling follow-up work across your tools before the meeting ends. Pi can also bring your boldest product and marketing ideas to life — landing pages, apps, social media content, ad campaigns and more live in the meeting. Less AI notes. More AI execution.

launches.name: tide
launches.tagline: A Jitsi alternative that does a few things really well
launches.description: tide is a simple, self‑hostable video conference service, alternative to Jitsi. It let's you host your own "meet.custom.domain" for a simple video conferencing environment with all core features you expect, including: link sharing, screen sharing, recording (server-side). A few things, done well.

launches.name: Assist
launches.tagline: Invisible assistant, that lives in your MacBook’s notch
launches.description: A personal, secure meeting assistant that lives in your MacBook's notch. Listens to your meeting · suggests what to say · invisible on screen share · can run 100% on your Mac

launches.name: Ahem! Unmissable Meeting Reminders
launches.tagline: Full screen reminders for ADHD, time-blind & focused brains
launches.description: Most calendar apps assume you'll glance at them. Ahem! assumes you won't. On Mac and Windows, full-screen reminders interrupt deep focus, and one hotkey reveals your day. On iPhone, live countdowns, Lock Screen reminders and Dynamic Island nudges keep your next meeting in sight. Built for ADHD, time blindness and deep focus. Works with Google, Outlook and iCloud calendars. Available in 17 languages. Pay once per app, no subscription.

launches.name: Patchcord
launches.tagline: Studio sound for your mic in every Mac meeting with EQ
launches.description: Patchcord is a macOS menu bar app that runs any Audio Unit plugin on your mic and hands the result to Zoom, Teams, Meet or Discord as a virtual mic. Use free plugins like RNNoise or pro tools like Antinode Clear. Every mic gets its own EQ with a live spectrum, switching mics mid-call just works, and Patchcord Camera keeps you in lip sync. Free to use, 7-day Pro trial, Pro is a one-time purchase. No account, no subscription.

launches.name: Claryoo
launches.tagline: The AI co-host that keeps every meeting awake
launches.description: Claryoo joins your Zoom, Meet or Teams call as a co-host. It runs polls, quizzes and Q&A, tells you who went quiet and which question is still waiting, and hands you what you owe the moment you hang up. Free for 2 meeting-hours a month.

launches.name: Calenoo
launches.tagline: Free Swiss scheduling polls and booking pages, no ads
launches.description: Two everyday scheduling jobs in one free tool. Availability polls: drop slots on a visual calendar, share a link; guests answer without an account and Calenoo highlights the best slot. Booking page: people book a free slot in your calendar, with an automatic video link and reminders. Link Google, Outlook, iCloud or Infomaniak to avoid double-booking. No ads, in English, French, German and Italian. Made in Switzerland, data hosted in Europe.

launches.name: Milago
launches.tagline: The AI Notetaker That Doesn't Stop at Notes
launches.description: Milago captures your meeting (browser, Windows app with no bot in the call, file upload, or a notetaker bot for Zoom, Meet and Teams), then writes the transcript with speaker labels, summary, decisions and action items. You approve them, each lands on an Action Board with an owner and due date, and goes out to Jira, Linear, GitHub, Notion, Slack, Teams or as a prompt for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex. Search and ask across every meeting, also via a hosted MCP server.

launches.name: Kolig
launches.tagline: The office for AI teammates that know your company
launches.description: Kolig is the office where AI teammates work with your company context and each other. Create specialists for product, marketing, sales, operations, and more, each with its own skills and memory. Shared Brain gives every role the company knowledge it needs, brings roles into chats and multi-role meetings, connects your tools, and turns their work into editable documents, images, spreadsheets, presentations, and PDFs. Your first 3 roles are FREE, so you can build a team and run real meetings.

launches.name: Google AI Edge Foresight
launches.tagline: Scribbles to complete meeting notes with on-device AI
launches.description: Google AI Edge Foresight is a companion app for virtual and in-person meetings that uses AI to transform quick meeting scribbles to thorough notes. It also helps ensure you always have the information you need with multimodal search and retrieval powered by the new EmbeddingGemma 2 model. Live Q&A automatically detects questions in dialog and answers them from your personal files. AI models run completely on-device without limits, connectivity, or subscription cost.

launches.name: Dimmy.app
launches.tagline: Turn your voice into a superpower! On your terms.
launches.description: Dimmy is an open-source voice app for macOS and Windows. Dictate clean text into any app with local Whisper, rewrite text by voice, and turn meetings into structured recaps. Bring your own AI (Claude, OpenAI, GEmini, your ChatGPT/Claude sub, or a local model). Free from source.

launches.name: Pluely 1.1
launches.tagline: Invisible AI overlay that transcribes calls and answers live
launches.description: Pluely is a native desktop overlay for macOS, Windows and Linux that stays invisible on screen shares and recordings. It listens to your call, transcribes it live with speaker labels, and drafts an answer the moment a question is asked. Ask mode takes a typed question, a screenshot or a file. New in 1.1: meeting detection, a transcription-only mode, an automatic recap with decisions and action items, and Pro purchase inside the app. Everything is stored on your computer. Free with your own key.

launches.name: beforewemeet
launches.tagline: Before the first hello. Get to know
launches.description: Answer 10 meaningful questions, share them with your person, and understand your values, mindset, and compatibility before deciding to meet.

launches.name: Fyka Retro
launches.tagline: Free sprint retrospectives. No account, nothing stored.
launches.description: Free sprint retrospective tool for agile teams. Run Mad/Sad/Glad, Start/Stop/Continue and custom retros in real time. No signup, no paywall, no data collection.

launches.name: METODIC Field Unit
launches.tagline: Plan a team offsite that actually gets decisions made
launches.description: Plan any workshop, training, or meeting in minutes. METODIC's AI builds the agenda, picks proven activities, and generates the materials, slides, and facilitator guide.

launches.name: Weaver
launches.tagline: Every meeting, woven into one answer
launches.description: Weaver builds a knowledge graph from your meetings. Paste a transcript, upload a recording or send a bot to your Zoom, Teams or Google Meet call, and it maps who was there, what was decided and what needs doing, then files it into the right project. Ask across the whole knowledge graph, for example "what did we decide about pricing last month?", and get an answer with citations to the meetings behind i

launches.name: Skrüm
launches.tagline: Open-source retrospectives, planning poker and team sessions
launches.description: Run retrospectives with 52 templates, estimate tasks with planning poker, brainstorm on shared whiteboards, check in with surveys and start with eight icebreakers. Keep actions visible after meetings, with owners, due dates and reminders. Skrüm is open source, self-hostable and available in four languages. Guests can join through session links.

launches.name: MeetMi
launches.tagline: Live AI advice during your meetings, on Mac and iPhone
launches.description: MeetMi gives live AI advice, running analysis and answers while people are still talking, then drafts notes with decisions and action items. It transcribes and translates on your Mac or iPhone; raw audio is never saved or uploaded, and no bot joins the call. Point it at a folder of your documents for grounded answers. Start with 250 free AI credits every week; the optional subscription adds 4,500 monthly credits and web research. Export as Markdown or plain text.
